study: Separate confidence routing from physical handover admission
design: The prior hardware-budget study filtered planned moves but left reactive handovers unrestricted. This test applies the same frozen expected-outage rule to both proposal paths.
gate_rule: Reuse OutageBudgetGate unchanged; all_handovers checks it after both planned and reactive proposals. It receives only observable candidate/current AP IDs and the causal forecast bank.
primary: All-handovers minus planned-only control-miss difference for distilled on six fresh sites
secondary: Same paired comparison for every reference, plus forecast-model comparisons and throughput tradeoffs
